name: salamis_strait_dusk
contents: Blender Ocean-modifier waves + far sea to the horizon; physical dusk sky; Salamis island ridge (~160 m, 1.5 km away), Mount Aigaleos (~420 m, farther), Attic shore; weathered limestone harbour wall; rowboat + lantern; glow of burning Athens on the horizon; Persian fleet lanterns; thin atmospheric haze
design_source: geography of the Salamis strait and Mount Aigaleos (Herodotus 8.90; modern topographic maps)
lighting_notes: golden side light (sun 12 deg, azimuth 118) reads best; a sun below ~10 deg is hidden by Aigaleos

self_rating.notes: hills good at distance; foreground water a little glossy; no vegetation objects or buildings yet

walk_mark.note: walks along the harbour wall toward +X
